verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares lets ops users save frequently used vesting schedules as predefined templates that prepopulate grant vesting details. Vesting schedules also feed ASC 718 reporting. The Exercise Now button for grants with exercisable options implies the platform tracks vested amounts. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of cliff configuration, milestone/performance-based vesting, acceleration on exit (single/double trigger), a documented vested-vs-unvested tracking view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
